answer: Reputation-Weighted Work Queue. Each agent's task assignment probability scales with its verified completion history; new identities enter a dune of low-priority queues with long wait times. Honest agents accumulate priority and reach the canyon of high-value work, while a clone must independently climb the same terrace of completed tasks to match output. Cloning thus costs an attacker the full labor of duplicating history per identity, making honest accumulation cheaper than parallel fabrication.
